research_mesh.freshness_rule: Consume newer incomplete run artifacts plus active Topic Packets/micro-packets when they supersede the latest final report.
research_mesh.governance_rule: Preflight fails closed if any explicit trigger priority does not cover exactly the scientific branch set registered in RESEARCH_TRIGGER_REGISTRY.json.
research_mesh.rule: Every scientific trigger ingests all seven connected branches before Fusion 1, scans contradictions and writes cross-links back. Clay is the integrated master foundry. ClayGraph is a scientific memory/knowledge-graph/database-substrate branch and is mandatory deep input to FRANK, ClayCode, GWT and Hyperposition.

active_domain_knowledge.selection_rule: Prefer a diverse active envelope of current/open material, contradictions, negative results, experiments, architecture constraints, cross-branch feedback and unresolved falsifiers; raw evidence expands on demand.
active_domain_knowledge.evidence_rule: Active/relevant does not mean true or promoted; shared ancestry still counts as one evidence family.

frank_architecture.rule: A FRANK run that produces only prose/diagrams/host-language code is incomplete. The architecture source of truth is ClayCode semantic IR and must cite ClayGraph substrate research; the deterministic host/bootstrap/capability authority remains explicitly non-self-authorizing.

frank_claycode_feedback.rule: ClayCode reads newest FRANK plus deep ClayGraph input, then independently tests materially imported FRANK assumptions. Shared source/experiment ancestry never counts as independent replication.

research_orchestration.fallback_behavior: Automatically continue with the best legacy/verified fallback when quota/provider/runtime/credential limitations prevent a planned call.
research_orchestration.promotion_behavior: Each failed/blocked MUST_ATTEMPT tool requires a successful fallback explicitly covering that tool before strong promotion.

worker_provider_bridge.rule: GitHub-connected workers unable to execute repo-local provider adapters directly enqueue an allowlisted request; Actions executes it with private credentials, writes a sanitized result, and caches 402/429 states for automatic future fallback.

visible_response.completion_rule: A substantive answer missing the required footer or short commands is not 100% complete.

external_research.secret_rule: By project-owner authorization, credentials may persist in the designated private-repository token store only when the active connector permits the write; values must never be copied into canonical research artifacts, reports, logs or visible responses.
